role_in_model: multiplies nitrification by K_comp/(K_comp+Xh), so nitrification halves once heterotroph biomass reaches this value
source: None. Heterotroph suppression of nitrifiers has not been measured on this system.
definition: Half-saturation of heterotroph crowding on nitrification. Nitrification is multiplied by K_comp/(K_comp+Xh), so when heterotroph areal biomass reaches K_comp the modelled nitrification rate is halved.

role_in_model: the total areal biomass at which the shared capacity term closes and no guild can grow further
source: Hassard et al. 2014 (doi:10.1016/j.psep.2014.07.003), the 151-412 um film band measured on RBC media; full text held.
definition: Carrying capacity of the film: the total areal biomass at which the shared capacity term closes and no guild can grow further. ASM/Wanner-Gujer call this X_max.

role_in_model: the areal nitrification rate at reference conditions; every other term in the flux chain scales it
source: Nemeth et al. 2023 -- a MEMBRANE-AERATED reactor, not an RBC. Reactor type differs from ours; full-text status not asserted in DATA_SOURCES.md.
definition: Reference areal nitrification rate at 20 C and reference nitrifier biomass. The multiplicative anchor of the whole flux chain: every other term scales it.

role_in_model: sets the submerged/emergent duty cycle and, through the rotating-disc correlation, the wall shear
source: Operator report, 4 rpm as presently run (verbal, 4 Nov 2026). Not instrumented.
definition: Wheel rotation rate. Sets the submerged/emergent duty cycle and, through the rotating-disc correlation, the wall shear the coupon feels.

role_in_model: the exponent in k_det proportional to tau^n; zero means detachment ignores shear entirely
source: Contested: Rittmann 1982 (doi:10.1002/bit.260240219) gives exponent 0.58; Peyton & Characklis 1993 (doi:10.1002/bit.260410707) find no significant shear effect. Both held in full text. Swept 0-1 rather than fixed because the literature disagrees.
definition: Exponent in k_det proportional to tau^n_shear. Zero means detachment ignores shear; one means it scales linearly with it.

role_in_model: the fraction of film lost per day before the shear modifier is applied
source: None.
definition: First-order detachment coefficient: the fraction of film lost per day before the shear modifier is applied.

role_in_model: scales the wall shear a recessed coupon feels; 1.0 is flush with the band
source: None at all. New with the band-mounted rig -- nothing measures how much a recessed coupon is sheltered from the free-stream.
definition: Divot shelter factor on wall shear. 1.0 is a coupon flush with the band; smaller values a deeper recess feeling less shear.

role_in_model: the areal attachment flux onto bare HDPE, multiplied by the material factor
source: None; anchored so that HDPE gains in one day the areal biomass v2 previously imposed as its initial condition.
definition: Areal attachment flux onto bare HDPE. The material factor multiplies it.

role_in_model: the substrate reaching the first stage; feeds heterotrophs, which then crowd the nitrifiers
source: Two influent samples only (BOD5 72-120 mg/L) plus the Primodal technical memorandum's ~100 mg/L onto the RBCs. The weakest field input -- n = 2.
definition: Biodegradable organic substrate reaching the first stage, carried as BOD5. Feeds the heterotrophs, which then crowd the nitrifiers.

role_in_model: Arrhenius coefficient on heterotroph growth; live here because these runs are at 15 C, not 20 C
source: Henze et al. 2000 (IWA ASM) convention -- suspended growth, not measured on a biofilm.
definition: Arrhenius temperature coefficient for heterotrophs. Inert in every result reported here: all runs are isothermal at 15 C.

role_in_model: phototroph decay and maintenance, including dark respiration
source: Edmundson & Huesemann 2015, night biomass loss in microalgae.
definition: Phototroph decay/maintenance coefficient, including dark respiration losses.

role_in_model: sets the oxygen penetration depth and so the effectiveness factor eta_O2
source: Copp (2024) plant model: the water value halved for the biofilm. An assumption in that model too.
definition: Effective oxygen diffusivity inside the film. Sets the penetration depth delta = sqrt(2 D S / R_v) and so the oxygen effectiveness factor eta_O2.

role_in_model: the lamp timer; light delivered is timer_h x (1 - f_wet), because a submerged coupon is a dark coupon
source: Sunrise-to-sunset at Rapid City (44.0805 N) at the solstices, standard refraction: 15.50 h summer, 8.87 h winter.
definition: Lamp timer setting. Light actually delivered is timer_h x (1 - f_wet), because a submerged coupon is a dark coupon.

role_in_model: half-saturation of the phototroph light response
source: None. A typical microalgal value with no source paper behind it.
definition: Half-saturation of the phototroph light response.

role_in_model: imposed bulk dissolved oxygen; a boundary condition, never a state
source: Copp (2024) plant model saturation at 20 C (9.09 mg/L) as the upper bound. Bulk dissolved oxygen on this rig is listed as NOT YET MEASURED.
definition: Imposed bulk dissolved oxygen. A boundary condition, never a state variable.

role_in_model: incident photon flux at the coupon before the divot view factor
source: Gross, Zhao, Mascarenhas & Wen 2016 (doi:10.1186/s13068-016-0451-z); full text held.
definition: Incident photon flux density at the coupon surface before the divot view factor.

role_in_model: Arrhenius coefficient on phototroph growth
source: Henze et al. 2000 (IWA ASM) convention -- suspended growth, not measured on a biofilm.
definition: Arrhenius temperature coefficient for phototrophs. Inert in every result reported here: all runs are isothermal at 15 C.

role_in_model: oxygen produced per unit phototroph biomass grown
source: Stoichiometric estimate from an assumed biomass formula CH1.8O0.5N0.2 (24.63 g/C-mol), not a measurement.
definition: Oxygen produced per unit phototroph biomass grown. The route by which light could in principle help nitrification -- and does not, because the film never runs out of oxygen.

role_in_model: half-saturation of phototroph phosphorus uptake
source: None. A typical microalgal value with no source paper behind it.
definition: Half-saturation of phototroph phosphorus uptake.

role_in_model: enters through the attachment factor and, for graphene, a maturation factor
source: Gross et al. 2016 seven-day areal biomass (fabric 91.2, HDPE 6.2, steel 3.3 g DW m-2), used as colonization factors. CAVEAT: this is a net seven-day retention ratio, not an attachment rate, and the fabric's fibre-scale area is absent from the model, so unmeasured area is currently being read as a material effect.
definition: Coupon material: HDPE (PE), bare steel (STL), graphene-coated steel (GRA) or fabric (FAB). Enters only through the attachment factor and, for GRA, a maturation factor.
